description: This file defines the class Header in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, containing static methods for parsing, normalizing, and splitting HTTP header values, specifically for handling list-based headers. It provides utility functions to process header data for HTTP message handling.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: A utility class for handling HTTP headers, providing static methods for parsing headers into structured data, normalizing headers, and splitting list headers.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an array of header values containing ';' separated parameters into an array of associative arrays representing key-value pairs of header parameters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts an array of header values that may contain comma-separated lists into a flat array of individual header values (deprecated, use splitList instead).

methods.name: splitList
methods.description: Splits a header value string (or array of strings) containing comma-separated values into an array of individual values, properly handling quoted substrings.
